# Take used-core-files list for r7t (regenerated by a script; replaces the r7r/r7s list)

Written by the r7t builder (order C-R7T-ADD, minor 6). Computed from the r7t tree by `take_closure.py` (python `ast`, reads text only, nothing of the repository is run).
Entry points: scripts/run_real_check.py and scripts/crash_desk.py (the child process the real check starts with sys.executable, run_real_check.py about line 833). The walk follows `import x`, `from x import y` (module level and inside functions), relative imports and literal strings given to importlib.import_module.

Result: 42 files in the closure; 391 (module, name) pairs are imported from them.

## What the earlier list (cut from the r7n patch, 162 files) got wrong or left open

- Its UNVERIFIED rows are resolved. demo_only/fakes_server.py: NOT in the closure (imported by no file of the closure; only tests/conftest.py and the text of tools/refusing_args.py name it). src/lead_desk/trace.py: NOT in the closure (no import of it from any closure file; the only `trace` import is the standard module `traceback` in scrub.py). demo_only/fake_model_server.py is also NOT in the closure (the earlier list said yes, that was wrong: DryFakes in run_real_check.py uses fake_hubspot, fake_imap and fake_smtp_tls only; a live run uses the real model host). demo_only/burst.py IS in the closure (imported by demo_only/portal_demo.py), the earlier list said no.
- The row `demo_only/bad_request.py: NO counterpart, not checked` was a real gap: demo_only/fake_hubspot.py imports `QuietServer` from it, so a take base without that file cannot start the dry fakes at all (import error). It is now in the closure and in the name list below.
- Dynamic imports: loader.py imports by a literal string `demo_only.fakes` (twice) and `demo_only.portal_demo` (followed); `_kind_module(name)` takes `HUBSPOT_MODULE`, `SMTP_MODULE` or `SMTP_PROVIDER_MODULE` (constants.py lines 148, 150, 185: lead_desk.crm_hubspot, lead_desk.smtp_outbox, lead_desk.smtp_provider), all of which are in the closure through static imports.
- Not covered by the walk (stated, not hidden): non-Python runtime files (schema.sql, demo_only/*.json, portal assets), anything run as a separate command (scripts other than the two entry points), and names reached by `getattr` with a built string. A star import would be listed below as a note; there is none.
